name: umo-mr
description: UMO MR — the org-default /mr command for creating GitLab merge requests, active whenever the developer or agent wants to create one: parses intent, autodetects the default branch, auto-chooses branch via protected + open-MR heuristic, organizes conventional commits, pushes and creates the MR immediately (glab preferred, GitLab MCP fallback), and optionally syncs JIRA.
